title: Large Retail H2 Revenue and Target Analysis
category: join four clean tables; filter H2 months; aggregate revenue by region and category; compare against targets; rank stores; summarise category profitability
atomic_operations: join stores with sales on StoreID
join products with sales on ProductID

compute net revenue after discount

aggregate H2 targets by Region and Category

rank stores by H2 revenue
summarise category revenue and gross profit

prompt: You have four clean tables: stores, products, monthly sales, and monthly targets. Join the tables using StoreID and ProductID, keep only the H2 2024 months (2024-07 to 2024-12), compute net revenue as UnitsSold × UnitPrice × (1 - DiscountPct), aggregate the results by Region and Category, and compare each aggregate to the summed H2 revenue target. Then create a Top 10 store leaderboard by H2 revenue and a category summary with revenue, gross profit, and discounted-unit share. Output everything into a new Excel workbook with three sheets: Region_Category_H2, Store_Leaderboard, and Category_Summary.
answer: Top H2 target achievement: Central / Sports at 189.8%. Highest-revenue store: Store_022 (North) with 9690.00. Most profitable category in H2: Sports with gross profit 8681.80.
feedback:
The four input tables are clean and fully keyed. I plan to compute net revenue after discount, restrict the analysis to 2024-07 through 2024-12, sum targets over the same scope, and then produce the three requested sheets.

---

conversations.content: Join the four clean retail tables, keep only H2 2024, compare actual revenue against targets by region and category, rank stores by H2 revenue, and summarise category profitability.

I will treat DiscountPct as a percentage reduction applied before aggregation, limit the scope to 2024-07 through 2024-12, and aggregate targets over the same region/category scope. Then I'll write the three result sheets.
Proceed.
Completed. Best H2 achievement is Central / Sports at 189.8%. The top store is Store_022 with H2 revenue 9690.00, and Sports leads gross profit.
